name: Agent Subcontracting Commercial Handoff
summary: Publish a machine-readable subcontracting surface that lets agents discover a human service provider, submit bounded jobs, use only server-authoritative published packages, and keep receipt, acceptance, payment, execution and completion as separate states.
problem: Agents often attempt work beyond their competence while service businesses expose only human-facing contact pages or unsafe checkout inputs, making delegation, pricing authority and execution state ambiguous.
coreOutcomes: Quote-first treatment for custom technical work
Explicit separation of receipt, acceptance, payment, authority, execution and outcome
Outside-in verification of the public subcontracting contract
requirements: A bounded API or equivalent intake mechanism
A proven payment provider for any published checkout path
Explicit repository/site mutation authority before technical work
Public discovery and outside-in verification capability
boundaries: Discovery or job receipt does not grant repository or production access
Caller-supplied prices, currencies or provider price identifiers are rejected
Custom work remains quote-first when no authoritative published price exists
Payment acceptance is not proof of technical completion or business outcome
Unsupported payment providers must not be advertised as configured
A successful intake request is not owner acceptance
